# prime-breadcrumb

prime-rs: Breadcrumb component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/breadcrumb) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-breadcrumb) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/breadcrumb.md)

Breadcrumb - port of `p-breadcrumb` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Root `nav.p-breadcrumb` (instead of the `<p-breadcrumb>` host), list `ol.p-breadcrumb-list`, the "home" item,
model items and separators. Instead of `MenuItem` with Angular router fields - `BreadcrumbItem` with `url`:
SPA navigation is driven by `command`. The `item` and `separator` templates are callbacks.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_breadcrumb::{Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbItem};

let model = vec![BreadcrumbItem::new().label("Electronics"), BreadcrumbItem::new().label("Computer")];
let html = view! { <Breadcrumb model=model home=BreadcrumbItem::new() /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-breadcrumb-home-item") && html.contains("Computer"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-breadcrumb = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["breadcrumb"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
